# Captured by `strand-site cli` from the strand binary (scripts/site/cli.sh); do not edit.
$ strand --help
usage: strand <command> [args]

commands:
  run               run the config [dir] (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/strand; --demo: the M0 hello bar)
  check             check the config without running it [dir | file]
  fmt               format .strand files in place [--check] [paths]
  watch             stream reload events, faults and notices (--json)
  reload            rescan now (--hard drops non-persisted state)
  get               read an exported value, a settings field or a token ('$accent') (--json)
  set               write an exported value, a settings field or an rw service field (strand set theme.look mocha; audio.sink.volume +5%; '$accent' overlays a token)
  toggle            flip an exported boolean
  call              invoke a service action (strand call notifications.clear) (--json)
  clear             drop a runtime overlay (strand clear '$accent')
  new               write a starter shell into [dir] (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/strand; refuses a non-empty dir)
  export            write the palette: json | base24 | --template <file> [--palette <expr>] [-o <file>]
  compositor-rules  print blur rules for the compositor
  report            dump compositor, protocols, scales, memory, GPU and frame stats (--json); with words (strand report the clock jumped), save a glitch report
  replay            replay a glitch report [report-dir] (default: the newest) in the evaluation sandbox and open its viewer (--no-open); needs strand-eval next to strand

options:
  --write-schemas   write this plugin binary's service schemas for strand check and the LSP
  -V, --version     print the version

environment (not passed to programs the shell starts):
  STRAND_SOCKET     the shell's socket (default $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/strand-<display>.sock)
  STRAND_STATE_DIR  the shell's state directory (default $XDG_STATE_HOME/strand)
$ strand run --help
usage: strand run [dir | --demo]
$ strand check --help
usage: strand check [dir | file]

Parses and type-checks every .strand file under the directory (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/strand) as one config and prints diagnostics; exits non-zero on errors. Given a file, checks it with the rest of its config (the default directory if the file is in it, else the file's directory) and prints the diagnostics in that file, and a missing lock helper.
$ strand fmt --help
usage: strand fmt [--check] [--] [dir | file]...

Formats .strand files in place (a directory means its .strand files, as `strand check` loads them; default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/strand). With --check, writes nothing, lists the files that are not formatted and exits non-zero if there are any. Files with syntax errors are reported and left as written.
$ strand watch --help
usage: strand watch [--json]
$ strand reload --help
usage: strand reload [--hard]
$ strand get --help
usage: strand get [--json] <file.name | '$token'>
$ strand set --help
usage: strand set <file.name> <value>
$ strand toggle --help
usage: strand toggle <file.name>
$ strand call --help
usage: strand call [--json] <service.action> [args…]
$ strand clear --help
usage: strand clear <'$token' | file.settings.field>
$ strand new --help
usage: strand new [dir]
$ strand export --help
usage: strand export json | base24 | --template <file> [--palette '<expr>'] [-o <file>]
$ strand compositor-rules --help
usage: strand compositor-rules [dir] [--classic]

Prints Hyprland layer rules that blur behind the surfaces of the config at dir (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/strand) that ask for `blur`, matched by their strand-<Name> namespaces, for you to paste into your Hyprland config. The default is Hyprland 0.56's Lua config (hl.layer_rule); --classic prints hyprlang `layerrule =` lines for older versions. Nothing is applied to the running session.
$ strand report --help
usage: strand report [--json] [what you saw…]
$ strand replay --help
usage: strand replay [report-dir] [--no-open] [--out DIR] [--to SCN] [--output NAME] [--traced SECONDS|all] [--frames all|failing|none] [--gpu]
       strand replay clip [report-dir] --from T [--to T] [--node SEL]... [--note TEXT] [--json] [--save FILE.zip]

Replays a glitch report (default: the newest under the state directory's reports/) in strand-eval, the evaluation sandbox, found next to strand or on PATH, which takes these options; `clip` makes a clip of the replay instead.
